items.item_text: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

The Financial Services Analyst 2 provides financial and administrative support for departmental operations within the Department of Surgery. Under general supervision, you will be responsible for processing financial transactions, preparing reports, reconciling accounts, and supporting compliance with University policies and procedures.

Key responsibilities include financial monitoring, data analysis, and coordination with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely financial operations. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to recognize implications, propose alternatives, and recommendations and implement solutions, analyze information to determine programmatic needs.
Working knowledge of principles of accounting and financial management.
Skill in prioritizing assignments to complete work in a timely manner when there are changes in workload, changes in assignments, and a heavy workload.
Demonstrated skill in financial analysis, planning, preparation, and administration of budget with multiple funding sources.
Skill in using Excel or other spreadsheet programs and database systems.
Skill in budget preparation and management, preparation of financial reports.
Demonstrated writing skills to compose logical, comprehensive, and grammatically correct correspondence, procedures, and reports.
Knowledge of university financial ledgers and accounting procedures.
